Get a dataframe of all sessions

get_GXPA_session_list.Rd

Like going to the page /sessions

Usage

get_GXPA_session_list(
  GXPA_TOKEN = Sys.getenv("GXPA_TOKEN"),
  server_url = Sys.getenv("GXPA_SERVER", "https://geneatlas.redda.bms.com/")
)

Arguments

GXPA_TOKEN

GXPA API token. Default is to use the environment variable GXPA_TOKEN

server_url

GXPA server (default GXPA_SERVER environment variable or https://geneatlas.redda.bms.com/ if missing)

Value

If successful, a dataframe of sessions and info about

See also

dry_run_session(), load_session()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
out.df <- get_GXPA_session_list()
out.df[grepl("blueprint", out.df$name), ]
session_id <- out.df[grepl("blueprint", out.df$name), "id"]
} # }
